parameters.name: KeyType
parameters.description:
The type of the ClientKey. Valid value:

- **DEVICE**: The key is a device ID.

parameters.name: TagName
parameters.description: Specifies the tag to unbind. To unbind multiple tags, separate them with commas. A maximum of 10 tags, each up to 128 characters long, can be unbound per request. The system supports a total of 10,000 tags.
